data.name: Literary Beacon Hill: The 20th Century
data.headline: LITERARY SERIES
data.description:
## Duration, Distance, Terrain
1.5 hours
1 mile at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
## About
Explore beautiful Beacon Hill as your guide takes you on a journey into the world of famous 20th century writers.

Learn the fascinating stories of Boston writers, including Robert Frost, Sylvia Plath and Robert Lowell, who called Beacon Hill home. Discover their colorful lives and personal styles as you explore the neighborhood where they worked.

## Meeting location:
Meet your guide at the corner of Tremont and Beacon Streets, in the plaza across the street from King's Chapel

Finding Your Guide: All guides carry an 8×11 sign that says “Boston By Foot Walking Tours.”

Nearest MBTA Stations: Government Center (Blue & Green Lines) or Park Street (Green & Red Lines)

## What to bring
Comfortable shoes, dress for the weather, water bottle
